scripts.title: Exordum Hub
scripts.features:
[DISCLAIMER] This script collects some data that includes: Time, Device Type, Executor, and Game Name. No personal or sensitive information is logged.
All logs are publicly viewable in the #🧾│execution-logs channel of my Discord server.
Side Notes: Comment here or message me on discord if you encounter any bugs!
Features:
* Information Tab:
- Local Info
[+] FPS
[+] Ping
[+] Time
- Server Info
[+] Game
[+] Player Count
[+] Server Region
- Game Info
[+] Current Destroyer
[+] Projectile
[+] Ramp Height
[+] Projectile Speed
- Other Info
[+] ExordumHub's Discord Server link
[+] Script Version
[+] Session Time
* Main Tab:
- Win (teleport to win button)
- Auto Win (auto teleport to win button)
- Reset if Destroyer (auto reset yourself if you are the destroyer)
* Teleport Tab:
- Get TP Tool (tool that tp you to where you click)
- Teleport to (dropdown)
[+] Destroyer
[+] Tower
[+] Spectator Area
* Anti Tab:
- Anti AFK (prevents you from getting kicked by afking)
- Anti KillBrick (remove the killbrick)
- Safe Platform (make a platform above the killbrick that you can walk on)
- Anti Fall (teleports you back on the tower if you fall down)
* Visuals Tab:
- Projectiles ESP (let you see the projectiles easier)
- Projectile ESP Outline (choose the esp's outline color)
- Projectile ESP Fill (choose the esp's fill color)
* Player Tab:
- Gravity (change your gravity)
- Walkspeed (change your walk speed)
- Loop Walkspeed (keep your walk speed after you die)
- JumpPower (change your jump power)
- Loop JumpPower (keep your jump power after you die)
- Infinite Jump (lets you jump mid air)
* Misc Tab:
- Anchor yourself (prevents you from getting pushed whatsoever)
- Noclip (let you clip through things [and push blocks])
- Fly (let you fly [great with noclip])
- View Player (let you spectate other players)
* Settings Tab:
- UI Theme (choose the UI's theme)
- Toggle Key (set the UI's open keybind [this option doesnt appear on mobile])
